t: A Developer's Guide to the Bing Search API Ecosystem
s: This guide details the Bing Search API suite, including web, image, news, and custom search capabilities, alongside integration with IndexNow for real-time updates and Bing Webmaster Tools for site management. It covers technical implementation, pricing, and AI integration within the Azure ecosystem.
sub: Bing Search API Suite (Web, Image, News, Custom, Entity, Visual)
IndexNow Protocol for real-time content indexing
Bing Webmaster Tools for site performance management
Azure AI Services integration and LLM use cases
RESTful API implementation, authentication, and data formats
